about: Amendment 1 to lift_test predictions (reports/2026-10-14_prediction_lift-test-amendment.md). The original results/predictions.json is unchanged and stays scored as filed (P1 reversed; P2's L_F term unscorable; P3 failed). P2' and P3' are new predictions, filed before either was run, motivated by what the first runs showed: the do-nothing map passes the masked KLs and L_F cannot see delta-W against ||Delta_0||^2 = 67.9, and the filed pull-back lr grid moved the weights 3-100x more than the W fine-tune.

predictions.claim: The Euclidean lift of a small fine-tune is a faithful decomposition of the fine-tuned model, and its components carry the update better than leaving them unchanged.
predictions.measure: at each rerun checkpoint 1, 2, 3, 5, 10: ratios r = metric / metric(W0) for the lift and for do-nothing; gap_recovered = (r_nothing - r_lift) / (r_nothing - 1) on unmasked_kl (Delta excluded)
predictions.pass: at every scorable checkpoint: stochastic and PGD ratios of the lift <= 1.5 AND gap_recovered >= 0.5
predictions.scorable: a checkpoint is scorable only if r_nothing(unmasked_kl) - 1 >= 0.2; the prediction is scorable only if at least one checkpoint is

predictions.claim: Post-training done in the decomposition at a step size matched to the W fine-tune reproduces the behaviour without extra off-target damage and keeps the decomposition faithful.
predictions.measure: the selected pull-back run: held-out P(o) per step; held-out kl_other at step 10; stochastic and PGD ratios at step 10 (also reported at step 30)
predictions.pass: held-out P(o) >= 0.9 by step 10 AND held-out kl_other at step 10 <= 2 x 0.0550 (the W fine-tune rerun's value at step 10) AND stochastic and PGD ratios <= 1.5 at step 10
reported: max per-matrix ||dW|| / ||W0|| at steps 1, 2, 3, 5, 10, 30 against the W fine-tune's

setup.do_nothing: components unchanged, target weights W0 + dW (Delta = Delta_0 + dW)
setup.euclidean_lift: per matrix, dU, dV = lift.euclidean_lift(dW, basis(U_A, V_A, tol 1e-6)); components U[alive] = (U_A + dU)^T, V[:, alive] = V_A + dV; target weights W0 + dW, so Delta = Delta_0 + O(dW) - dU dV^T
setup.faithfulness: round 1's harness (2 blocks of 128 Pile val rows 0..255; stochastic, PGD 20 x 0.1 one adversary per block, CI-masked and unmasked KL with Delta excluded); ratios to the released decomposition on W0 recomputed in the same job
setup.pullback: Adam on the alive (U, V) offsets (src/commute/pullback.py), Delta_0 and dead columns fixed, arm A's loss, windows, batch 32, clip 1, seed 0; lr in {1e-5, 2e-5, 3e-5}; 30 steps; held-out eval every step
setup.pullback_selection: among lrs with held-out P(o) >= 0.9 at step 30, the one with the lowest held-out kl_other at step 30; if none, the highest held-out P(o) at step 30
setup.updates: the arm A rerun (Adam, lr 3e-5, round 1's recipe), checkpoints 1, 2, 3, 5, 10 (results/large/A_rerun/dW_step*.pt; s* = 1, evals in results/pullback.json)
